correctness.rationale: The repaired claim treats the natural maximum-line-triple stratum without A3. For one smooth conic and five lines, the smooth-branch ADE list and Bézout give tau=20+t+e+r, with t tangents, e on-conic line crossings and r off-conic line triples. The two triples share exactly one line. Putting it at infinity identifies their four residual crossings with the corners of a 2-by-2 grid. The shared line is secant by absence of A3 and because both centers lie off the conic. Tangents among the grid lines can only occur at a corner and cannot share it. With e<=2, t+e<=4; e=4 also gives t+e=4 since every grid line is secant. With e=3 there are two secants and at most two tangents, so equality requires both remaining lines tangent. Permute the corners by reversing coordinates so the omitted corner is (1,1); the equation is A u(u-1)+Buv+D v(v-1)=0 with AD nonzero. One-variable restrictions on u=1 and v=1 give B=D and B=A, completing classification. Homogenization by u=-y/x and v=-z/x recovers the stated f. Its smoothness, tangent locations, transverse nodes and complete multiplicity budget give the reported basket. Exact integer Saito identities suffice for freeness; independently recovering the degree-three kernel gives dimension 2 and a nonzero determinant quotient -147/40 for a different basis (python /workspace/independent_checks.py 3). The τ=27 stratum bound and uniqueness do not rely on the cited unrestricted upper bound.
residual_risks: Only unmarked complex projective equivalence within the specified stratum. Other equality strata, positive characteristic and non-ADE arrangements are not classified.

value.rationale: The five-line skeleton is singled out by attaining the maximum number of line-only triple points. The absence of isolated tangency asks whether every tangency can be absorbed into a triple point at the known optimum. The repair answers both the realization and projective-moduli question for this geometric stratum: no family remains and both tangencies are forced. This is stronger than an extra example or an unmotivated selection of a numerical basket, and distinguishes the contribution from the already-known numerical extremum.
residual_risks: No rigidity assertion about other strata or about automorphism groups of the representative.
